team-details.description-text: Full-stack development focused on solutions for the real estate sector, building management platforms with Laravel. I also develop mobile apps and AI servers, working with Next.js and Nest.js depending on each project's needs.
I have developed and designed various modules and sections for platforms created by the company, working with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and FlutterFlow to meet the standards of these tools.

finance.name: Finance
finance.description: Personal finance app to keep your net worth under control in real time
finance.paragraph: Finance is a personal finance app built for the Colombian market, where you can log income, expenses, and investments in seconds. Connect your bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets, set savings goals, and track your net worth with clear charts. It includes stock and crypto investment modules, high-yield savings accounts, category budgets, a built-in financial calculator, and a tax summary that flags when you cross the income-tax filing threshold. Available on web, iOS, Android, and Telegram.

estella.name: ESTELLA
estella.description: Online store for handmade mirror-finish accessories
estella.paragraph: Estella is an online jewelry and accessories store, handmade in Colombia. The site features the full collection filterable by category (bracelets, necklaces, rings, and earrings), product pages with measurements and materials, an editorial lookbook with seasonal photography, and a personalized WhatsApp advisory flow to answer questions before buying. Built for a warm, feminine shopping experience, with insured nationwide shipping and gift wrapping included.

impetu.name: ÍMPETU
impetu.description: E-commerce landing page for a men's grooming brand
impetu.paragraph: Ímpetu is the launch site for a men's personal care brand, built around its first product: beard-refreshing wipes. The landing page pairs punchy, character-driven copy with a three-step how-it-works section, product benefits, a catalog of upcoming launches, and checkout. Designed with a dark, violet visual identity meant to feel energetic and stand out in the grooming market.

daniela-photo.name: Daniela Zuluaga — Photography
daniela-photo.description: Portfolio site for a visual photographer specialized in product and food photography
daniela-photo.paragraph: Portfolio website for Daniela Zuluaga, a visual photographer based in Medellín. It presents her story and specialties (product, commercial, and food photography), a selected-works gallery laid out as a timeline, and a detail page for each series with role, tools used, and image gallery. It includes direct WhatsApp and Instagram contact to book new shoots.

estilo-elite.name: ESTILO ÉLITE
estilo-elite.paragraph: A family-run startup created by Brayan Vargas and Camilo Vargas, focusing on the sale of high-quality watches and accessories for men. The business aims to provide customers with stylish and affordable products, offering a curated selection of watches and accessories that combine elegance and functionality, perfect for modern men.

task-flow.name: Task Flow
task-flow.paragraph: Task Flow is a tool designed to optimize task and project management, allowing users to organize, prioritize, and efficiently track their activities. With an intuitive interface and features such as task assignment, progress tracking, and personalized notifications, this platform is ideal for both teams and individuals. Task Flow aims to simplify workflows, improve productivity, and ensure that goals are effectively achieved. (Join with the admin credentials: email: 'Brayangomez521@gmail.com', password: 1234')

blooma.name: blooma
blooma.paragraph: A platform where designers and developers can apply for jobs that pay with platform credits. Users can post their work and earn credits that can be exchanged for various services within the platform. It aims to connect talent with companies in need of creative and technical expertise, offering a secure and innovative way of working on freelance projects.

abc.name: ABC CINEMATOGRAPHY
abc.paragraph: A platform for searching movies allows you to easily discover titles from all genres, explore reviews, and get details about the cast, synopsis, and availability across different streaming services. With an intuitive interface and advanced filters, you can find the perfect movie based on your mood, preferences, or popularity. Additionally, some platforms offer personalized recommendations based on your tastes and search history to enhance your cinematic experience. Find your next favorite movie in seconds! 🎬🍿
images: Movie details, creation date, genres, description, involved companies, and trailer

chatea.name: CHATEA
chatea.description: Interactive platform to connect and chat in real time
chatea.paragraph: Chatea is a modern platform that allows users to communicate instantly with people from all over the world. Developed with WebSockets, Node.js, and React, it offers a smooth, secure, and dynamic chat experience. It includes public and private rooms, real-time notifications, and an intuitive interface that makes interaction between users easy, fostering new connections and meaningful conversations.
images: App login, you can use any user
Chat interface, you can send messages and see messages from other users, as well as the sending time

proveo.name: Proveo
proveo.paragraph: A dropshipping platform is an ideal solution for entrepreneurs who want to sell products online without worrying about storage or shipping. By connecting sellers with suppliers, this tool automates order management, allowing products to be shipped directly from the supplier to the end customer. This reduces operational costs and makes it easier to build a scalable business. Additionally, many platforms include integrations with online stores, sales analytics, and marketing tools to maximize e-commerce success. 🚀💼
images: Filter by category, price, color, etc.

hojarasca.name: hojarasca
hojarasca.paragraph: A website designed for a Colombian restaurant, featuring a user-friendly interface for customers to view the menu, order food online, and find restaurant details. It also includes an admin panel for managing orders and updating the menu. The platform enhances the dining experience with vibrant visuals and an easy navigation system, bringing Colombian flavors closer to customers.

nasa.name: NASA date
nasa.paragraph: A website that integrates the NASA API to display a new photo from space each day. Users can interact with a calendar to view photos from previous days. The site includes translations for different languages, providing an educational and visually captivating experience for anyone interested in space exploration and astronomy.

portfolio.name: Portfolio plain
portfolio.paragraph: A simple, functional portfolio built using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a clean and easy-to-navigate design. It is fully responsive, adapting to all devices. The portfolio includes a project section with images and descriptions, and a contact form. Smooth transitions between sections are achieved with JavaScript, providing a fluid and user-friendly experience. Ideal for showcasing basic web development skills without complexity.

todo.name: Todo app
todo.paragraph: A productivity app that allows users to manage tasks using a simple and intuitive interface. It lets users add, edit, and mark tasks as complete, helping them stay organized. The app supports different types of tasks, offering an easy way to track progress and plan the day efficiently.

triki.name: Tic tac toe
triki.paragraph: A simple Tic-Tac-Toe game where players aim to align three of their objects in a row to win. It features an interactive board, and the game logic ensures a smooth and enjoyable experience. Players can challenge each other in this timeless game of strategy.

white-car.name: white car
white-car.paragraph: At Whitecar, our mission is to provide safe, reliable, and efficient ground transportation for all our clients. We strive to be industry leaders, offering innovative solutions that exceed expectations and contribute to the well-being of our community.
